title: Best Career Coaches Online (2026): Plan Your Next Career Move
description: How to hire a career coach for career changes, job search strategy, interview practice or skills planning: format, deliverables, how to brief it and red flags.
intro: Career coaches help people plan their working lives: exploring new directions, planning career changes, improving job search strategies, practicing interviews and preparing for promotions or salary conversations. Good coaching is practical, honest and based on your situation. It goes wrong when advice is generic, coaches promise jobs, or sessions leave you without clear next steps. This guide helps you find career support that moves you forward.

faq.q: What can a career coach help with?
faq.a: Career direction, job search plans, CVs and profiles, interview practice, networking and negotiation preparation.

faq.q: How many sessions do I need?
faq.a: Often a few sessions over weeks, depending on your goal.
